interpretations.queue-fairness: Actual independent processes complete successfully but work log reverses to fast-second then slow-first.
interpretations.queue-await-work: First failed assertion observes API settled while callback remains pending; later holder existence and kernel contention assertions are not reached in RED.
interpretations.own-ticket-scan: Early ordering: later native guard still refuses; RED observes that the mutex was created.
interpretations.pid-validation: All three invalid PID cases first fail no-filesystem-side-effects; downstream ticket grammar/range guards still refuse.
interpretations.stamp-validation: Explicit diagnostic boundary: later ticket-name grammar still refuses; RED first sees a different diagnostic, before the no-filesystem assertion.
interpretations.wait-validation: Negative wait is admitted; fractional and Infinity waits still fail downstream BigInt conversion but first observed assertions prove queue creation. Test label null denotes JSON.stringify(Infinity), not null input.
interpretations.label-validation: Empty/newline labels still refuse downstream but after filesystem effects; CR and NUL cases are admitted.
interpretations.ticket-exclusive-publication: Collision refusal: overwrite mutant resolves instead of rejecting. Subsequent original-byte preservation assertion is not reached in RED.
interpretations.record-unknown-content: Unknown record content must prevent admission; recursive-removal mutant resolves. Subsequent operator-byte preservation assertion is not reached in RED.
interpretations.record-independent-cleanup: First assertion directly observes holder unlink not attempted after label unlink failure.
interpretations.holder-publication-order: Injected holder-write boundary observes label write has not happened; outer failure identity differs.
interpretations.ticket-label: Specified no-label positional line is admitted as label el by mutant. This demonstrates that case, not independent coverage of all missing/empty label arms.
interpretations.request-capture: Actual reached fault is rereading mutable request.label; no independent runtime-function-copy proof from this mutant.
interpretations.monotonic-budget: Mutant > instead of >= makes three polls instead of two at the exact budget boundary; does not independently prove all clock wiring.

limitations: Qualified on current Linux/x64 Bun1.4.4 only; Darwin path selection is tested as a pure mapping, not a Darwin native runtime.
Status is an observation and cannot certify kernel ownership; raw corrupt holder text is intentionally preserved.
Stable trusted parent namespaces and cooperating writers are required; path cleanup does not claim atomic identity comparison against hostile namespace replacement.
Only ESRCH proves process death. EPERM and other unexpected probe failures throw. Cleanup failures throw after all known actions are attempted.
Cancellation stops admission; entered work settles before record cleanup and native release. Executable signal-code mapping and descendant ownership remain in the later helper/caller slice.
Unknown record content is retained/refused; ordinary empty record paths can be removed. No recursive removal of unknown record artifacts.
Actual old Bash/Perl peers remain bounded test specimens for migration compatibility. Their active production consumers remain until coherent switching.
